INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST

SUMMARY
Information Technology Specialist experienced in workstation setup, user training, process improvement, infrastructure, data management, enterprise operations, network/project/emergency management, hardware installation, software patching, internal system configuration, equipment maintenance, software updates and network security.

SKILLS
Routers, staff management, hardware troubleshooting, network administration, Cisco, help desk support, Cisco switching, Cisco routers, hardware installations, learning strategies, software updates, repair, system testing software, operation monitoring, problem solving, end-user support, device configuration, hardware/software installation, technical support, security protocols and security oversight.

EXPERIENCE
Information Technology Specialist, 02/2015 - 02/2021
Created accounts, reset passwords and configured server/file management access. Researched system and database issues, maintained records/logs/lifecycle documentation, mentored support professionals, improved IT uptime and cost reduction, coordinated performance assurance and automated performance test scripts, reviewed support cases, tested network/workstation/peripheral performance, functionality and security, developed backup and recovery protocols, maintained server room, wireless network and server infrastructure, developed mitigation strategies and SOPs, assessed bug reports/enhancement requests, provided post-implementation support, implemented unit/integration testing, authored training manuals, supported thousands of staff with onsite IT/AV support, developed online documentation, patched and licensed systems, and trained users on technical tools.

Computer Repair Technician, 06/2016 - 02/2017
Performed diagnostics, software updates, backups, hardware failure identification, laptop/desktop upgrades, help desk support, Lenovo repairs, printer/peripheral configuration, security patch installation, malware/virus removal and user troubleshooting.

Correctional Officer, 03/2014 - 12/2014
Maintained records, logs, communication and security operations.

EDUCATION
Some college coursework in technology.
